q: Which is the highest peak of Odisha?
Which is the highest waterfall of Odisha?
x: Barehipani in Similipal. Joranda is also in Similipal; Duduma is in Koraput; Khandadhar in Sundargarh.

q: Which is the largest freshwater lake of Odisha?
x: Ansupa in Cuttack district. Chilika is brackish (a lagoon).

q: The Brahmani river is formed by the meeting of which two rivers?
x: They meet at Vedavyas near Rourkela.

q: Which of these is NOT a mass nesting site of olive ridley turtles in Odisha?
x: The three mass nesting (arribada) sites are Gahirmatha, the Rushikulya mouth and the Devi mouth.

q: In which year was Chilika removed from the Montreux Record?
x: Chilika was put on the Montreux Record in 1993 and removed in 2002 after the new sea mouth improved it.

q: Which place in Odisha is famous for chromite?
x: Sukinda (and Baula-Nuasahi). Panchpatmali = bauxite, Talcher = coal, Barbil = iron ore.
Panchpatmali hills in Koraput; the refinery is at Damanjodi and the smelter at Angul.

q: Who led the Paika Rebellion of 1817?
x: Bakshi Jagabandhu Bidyadhar led it in Khurda in 1817.

q: Who founded the Utkal Sammilani in 1903?
x: Madhusudan Das (Utkal Gourab) founded it to unite Odia-speaking areas.

q: Where was the salt satyagraha held in Odisha?
Who was the first Chief Minister of Odisha after independence?
x: Harekrushna Mahtab. Biswanath Das was Odisha's first Prime Minister (Premier) in 1937.

q: Who built the Sun Temple at Konark?
x: Narasimha Deva I of the Eastern Ganga dynasty, 13th century. Chodaganga Deva began the Jagannath temple at Puri.

q: Which of these is NOT a Ramsar site of Odisha?
x: Odisha's six Ramsar sites: Chilika, Bhitarkanika, Satkosia, Tampara, Hirakud and Ansupa.
